It reaches frontend/ and extension/ only through the lint toolchain (@vue/eslint-config-typescript > fast-glob > micromatch > braces), runs on developer and CI machines against glob patterns written in the repository, and is never part of a build output. Drop this entry as soon as a patched braces is published.

No fixed release exists: the advisory covers every version up to 4.0.7, the latest published (both the 4.x line and the 2.3.2 pulled in by micromatch). It reaches frontend/ and extension/ only through build, test and lint tooling (vite, vitest, tinyglobby, unplugin, npm-run-all2, vue-router's build-time route generator, micromatch), where the glob patterns are written in the repository, never supplied by a user, and picomatch is never part of a build output. Drop this entry as soon as a patched picomatch is published.
